sourceFile: 43.MSU-20S15-07 Result test  frame improve dimension mold G3-G4 date 22.9.2025 - Copy_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Comparable G3/G4 frame-improvement validation exists, but the draft grouping and metrics are unreliable.
issues: Changed factor wrongly lumps G3, G4, normals, TOTAL, and unrelated K1/G2 labels.
Subgroup keys are parsed numeric values, not valid row-level grouping keys.
Several outcomes are misparsed, including header-derived measurements and 100% rates from NG counts.
Sheet1/K1 data inclusion is ambiguous and may be duplicate or unrelated context.
Evidence cites many rows but mixes titles, headers, totals, and partial rows without clean comparisons.
requiredUserQuestions: Should Sheet1 K1 data be included or excluded from this G3/G4 validation case?
correctionPlan: Define primary factor as frame dimension 0.78 improved mold G3/G4 versus normal line/control.
Keep G3 and G4 as separate changed conditions or subgroups under the same validation report.
Rebuild outcomes from height dimension, function, tension, and module-line sections with correct inputs, NG, rates, and dates.
Use line/model/mold/date/test section as subgroup keys; remove numeric garbage and TOTAL as a condition.
Cite only rows that contain title/purpose, baseline/test rows, totals, and decisions needed for each comparison.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are not sufficient until regrouped and limited to relevant comparison rows.
